cases.name: app-runtime-pack-awareness
cases.prompt: Before doing anything else, list the enabled tool packs in this chat and identify which one controls live desktop interaction.
cases.notes: App Runtime is reasoning-only, so this case checks pack awareness without requiring a tool call.

cases.name: interactive-desktop-screen-check
cases.prompt: Use the live desktop tools to tell me the main app or window currently visible on screen. Do not use workspace, web, or isolated browser tools for this.

cases.name: browser-isolated-example-heading
cases.prompt: Using the isolated browser, open https://example.com and tell me the main heading text. Do not use live desktop tools for this.

cases.name: workspace-read-list-current-dir
cases.prompt: Inspect the current workspace and list the top-level files and folders. Do not change anything.

cases.name: workspace-write-create-and-run
cases.prompt: In the current workspace, create hello_eval.py that prints 'hello from eval', run it, and tell me the output.

cases.name: web-research-current-fact
cases.prompt: Search the web for the current capital of Belgium and return the answer with one source URL.

cases.name: scheduler-create-disabled-job
cases.prompt: Create a disabled hourly scheduled job named eval_ping that echoes ping, then confirm it exists by listing scheduled jobs.

cases.name: multi-pack-read-then-write
cases.prompt: Read README.md in the current workspace, create eval_summary.txt with a one-sentence summary of it, then verify the new file contents.

cases.name: multi-pack-browser-then-write
cases.prompt: Using the isolated browser, open https://example.com, capture the main heading, write it to example_heading.txt in the current workspace, and verify the saved file.

cases.name: multi-pack-research-then-write
cases.prompt: Search the web for the current capital of Belgium, write the answer and one source URL to belgium_capital.txt in the current workspace, then verify the saved file.

cases.name: multi-pack-screen-then-write
cases.prompt: Use the live desktop tools to identify the main visible app or window title, write it to screen_observation.txt in the current workspace, and verify the saved file.

cases.name: multi-pack-scheduler-then-write
cases.prompt: Create a disabled hourly scheduled job named eval_note_job that echoes note, confirm it exists by listing scheduled jobs, then write scheduler_note.txt in the current workspace containing the job name and verify the saved file.
